summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature as specified. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file with overloads, Progress.open with overloads, Progress.wrap_file); tests/test_progress.py (22 new tests before the __main__ block); docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Added entry, PR 1759). Nothing was run, per instructions, and nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only. Points to check when running the suite: the repo's strict mypy will flag any suppression that turns out unused, so the return-value/type-var ignores on the module-level returns need confirming; and Progress.open creates the task before opening the file, so a missing path with an explicit total leaves a task behind, as the spec's step order implies. Also, the module-level open calls progress.open through a Callable-typed binding to avoid an overload mismatch with a str mode, which is not a suppression.
